Class ContractState

java.lang.Object
org.engine.contract.ContractState
Direct Known Subclasses:
ReussiteState, TrickTakingState
public abstract class ContractState extends Object
The in-progress state of a Barbu contract.

Created by Contract.start(Player, Map) and updated by applyMove(Move). Not mutated in place, every move returns a new instance.

    • withHands

      public abstract ContractState withHands(Map<Player,Hand> newHands)
      Creates a copy of this contract state, replacing the current hands with the provided ones. Used by AI for determinization.
      Parameters:
      newHands - the hypothetical distribution of cards
      Returns:
      a new state identical to this one, but with the new hands

    • impossibleCards

      public abstract Map<Player, Set<Card>> impossibleCards()
      Cards each player is provably not holding, derived from observed play history. Updated as moves are applied (off-suit follows in trick-taking; passes in Réussite). Preserved unchanged by withHands(Map) — constraints are historical, not hand-specific. Used by AI for determinization.

    • applyMove

      public final ContractState applyMove(Move move)
      Applies move to this state and returns the resulting state.
      Parameters:
      move - the move to apply; must be a legal move for the current player
      Returns:
      the new state after the move
      Throws:
      IllegalMoveException - if this contract is already finished
